nursery_days.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
nursery_days.quote: Transplant 40-45 days old seedlings at 30 cm spacing.

days_to_first_harvest.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
days_to_first_harvest.note: From the TNAU fertigation table: 165 days from transplanting minus the 95-day harvesting stage = first picking at about 70 days.

spacing_row_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
spacing_row_cm.quote: Form ridges and furrows 45 or 60 cm apart.
spacing_row_cm.note: The page gives 45 or 60; the wider is used.

spacing_plant_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
spacing_plant_cm.quote: Transplant 40-45 days old seedlings at 30 cm spacing.

water_need.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
water_need.quote: Irrigation at weekly or 10 days interval.
water_need.note: Interpreted: watering once a week is read as 'low', every few days as 'medium'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

waterlogging_tolerant.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
waterlogging_tolerant.quote: Well drained loamy soil rich in organic matter.

kc.title: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, chapter 6: Table 12, single crop coefficients (Kc)
kc.note: Kc ini is the group value.

root_depth_cm.title: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, chapter 8: Table 22, maximum effective rooting depth
root_depth_cm.note: The lower end of FAO's range is stored (the page says the smaller values suit irrigation scheduling).

source_notes: AI research batch 6 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound unless a note says otherwise; the source range is in each quote. Sow windows are TNAU plains months (Tamil Nadu) until a Malwa source is found.
